wire.marker: enclosing authenticated KindHealth packet number strictly greater than peer outbound DATA window last PN

scope.sender: peer authenticated 256 PN post Emit KindLINK success and local drops
scope.receiver: own authenticated first-unique KindLINK in peer matching PN interval
scope.age_check: peer sender DATA age <=10s and known
scope.capacity: >=256 PN span or retention limited => CAPACITY
scope.state: receiver-local ESTIMATED first arrival deficit only after all checks; otherwise UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT/CAPACITY/STALE
scope.auth: same TLS record key nonce/ref and peer generation+seq mailbox

tests.pure: maturity, report sequence with stable PN, marker missing, stale, insuff/capacity
tests.actual: two roles, original encrypted KindHealth, 20 local outbound DATA, omit one tail and RTOs, advance 3s, expected estimated 1/20 local only
